chapter: Arriving in New York and founding the Afro-Cubans
title: Arrival in New York and the Savoy
summary: He stayed with his sister Estela and went nightly to the Savoy to hear Chick Webb, where Mario was rehearsing the band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: You did. Okay. When you got here, try to think back now, it's October, nineteen thirty ----
---thirty-seven when you got here. Where did that ship land - dock?
Okay, and then where did you go from there?
From there my sister took me to her house.....
Estela. Okay, and you lived there for a while 'till you got situated?
Yes, and I used to go practically every day, every night, to the Savoy because Chick Webb was there building the - - over the radio - the band with Ella Fitzgerald.
Ahh, Mario was in Chick Webb's band at the time?
Yes, he was in charge of rehearsing the orchestra. He was the one to start the band and everything.
